race.comment: CABLE KING (5) was sound off a freshen behind Carricaz (race 2) and that form may have been franked earlier in the card. Out to 1200m now looks a good move and McKenzie rode him well from the tricky gate last time. Finds the right race here and can get the job done. OVERSHOOT (4) was just fair in her only trial at Warwick Farm and has been switched to the Cleary barn since that effort in December. Hasn't been sighted since, though she finds a suitable race for her return. Wouldn't surprise to see her come out and score on debut. THIRSTY FOR MORE (3) finished soundly on debut at Narrandera and should be better suited getting out to this distance. Loy replaces the apprentice hoop and he can notch up a maiden win without surprising. MOGO ROCK (11) gets the blinkers on now and a good draw. Can feature.
